verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's own Warehouse Connectors sync data from Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Redshift, and Postgres into Mixpanel, with Mirror change tracking. That gives a first-party bulk-ingestion path for historical event data once it has been staged in a warehouse. The export APIs run in the wrong direction, and the partner tools (Census, Vendo) are third-party, so neither counts. Missing for 10: a documented bulk import API or file-based upload, direct migration from other analytics tools, explicit handling of historical timestamps and backfill limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can bulk-import historical events from another analytics tool or a data export into the platform

citations.quote: With Warehouse Connectors, you can sync data from data warehouses like Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Redshift, and Postgres to Mixpanel.
Mixpanel will create and manage the necessary STREAM objects in the \MIXPANEL\ schema
